issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 05 returns the column 'avg_flaeche' by aliasing the textual column 'kreis' (kreis as avg_flaeche) instead of computing an average area. This makes the 'avg_flaeche' column a duplicate of the Kreis name (string) rather than a numeric AVG(flaeche) as required by the problem statement, causing a semantic/type mismatch and contradicting the task specification.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution replace the incorrect alias with an aggregate expression: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) as avg_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis. This ensures avg_flaeche is numeric and matches the task (average area per Kreis) while keeping the required grouping and ordering.
